title: Draft Indian Standard FOR BLACK LEAD PENCILS SPECIFICATION Second Revision of IS 1375
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the requirements for various types of pencils such as drawing pencils, carpenter’s pencils, stenographer’s and reporter’s pencils, and pencils for general writing.
clause_3_terminology: Draft Indian Standard FOR BLACK LEAD PENCILS SPECIFICATION Second Revision of IS 1375

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
